signal: CEI rebranded to cei.ai in March 2026 and appointed a new CSO and CMO to drive an AI-first enterprise systems-integration strategy

email.body1:
Lisa, saw CEI move to cei.ai and bring on a new CSO and CMO to drive the AI-first enterprise strategy.

A pivot that public usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can touch, and good-fit enterprise buyers go cold before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for CEI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lisa, quick follow-up for CEI.

With a new CSO and a repositioned brand, pipeline expectations rise faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CEI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lisa, last bit of proof for CEI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CEI's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise tech-services teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lisa, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most during a rebrand and a new CSO ramp, which is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to CEI either way.
